expectations.text: Includes QC 1000 awareness: effective December 15, 2026 for audit firms
expectations.evidence: "Also note QC 1000 takes effect December 15, 2026. It governs the audit firm, not your controls, but ask your auditor whether it changes their timetable or evidence requests."

expectations.text: Uses the October 22, 2026 PCAOB Spotlight on 2025 inspections to anticipate auditor focus areas
expectations.evidence: The October 22, 2026 Spotlight is never mentioned; the only statistics cited are KPMG/Audit Analytics material weakness rates and Baker Tilly repeat-filer data.

expectations.text: Covers the core ITGC domains (access, change management, IT operations)
expectations.evidence: Dedicated sections for "Access to programs and data," "Program changes," and "Computer operations" (plus program development).

expectations.text: States the current 404(b) framework applies because the SEC proposal has seen no final action
expectations.evidence: "Confirm filer status and whether 404(b) applies this year. Current thresholds are operative. Flag the SEC's May 19, 2026 proposal, which has no final action as of November 6, 2026."

expectations.text: Ties recommendations to correct dates rather than invented deadlines
expectations.evidence: Dates used are accurate (May 19, 2026 proposal; no final action as of November 6, 2026; QC 1000 effective December 15, 2026); no fabricated deadlines appear.
